g.text: Engine = originator, WorkflowSnapshotCaretaker = caretaker, WorkflowRunMemento = memento
Normal execution: one memento before every node
[node fails after its retries and has no onFail edge]
200 "Rolled back to snapshot #n; the run is paused at node X"
(and is snapshotted again under the same sequence)
- Snapshots are stored in WorkflowSnapshot, so they survive restarts.
- The run keeps the definition version it started with (workflowDefVersion).
- Files in the project workspace are not part of the memento: re-run agents rewrite them.
- Sub-workflow runs are not snapshotted; rolling back the parent re-runs the whole sub_workflow node.
